title: Cannabinoid measurement
description: One cannabinoid analyte reading. Core does not constrain the set of valid codes (THC, THCA, CBD, CBDA, CBG, CBN, ...) — jurisdiction profiles may require specific analytes to be present.

code.description: Cannabinoid code, e.g. THC, THCA, CBD, CBDA, CBG, CBGA, CBN, HHC.

basis.description: What the value is measured against, resolving the mg-vs-percent ambiguity.
